gp-2024-11-hartland.title: Lights on at Hartland
gp-2024-11-hartland.caption:
A November weekend away for Ted & Lola. We rolled into Hartland on the Friday evening, got the lights and the windbreak up and settled in for the weekend.
Saturday and Sunday were all about walks on the beach in the winter sunshine, good food and a few drinks, before heading home on the Sunday 🩶🤍

gp-2025-05-croyde.title: Sunshine at Croyde
gp-2025-05-croyde.caption:
Ted & Lola pitched up side by side at Putsborough for a weekend at Croyde, with the chairs out and the sun shining.
Sunny walks on the beach, good food and a few drinks made for the perfect weekend away 🩶🤍
